pr_title: Update knx climate so it can be used with AC
pr_body:

## Breaking change

  Can't really say if it brakes anything, but possibly yes, I don't have a variety of hardware to test it with. 


## Proposed change

  Changes were proposed by @jncanches here: https://github.com/home-assistant/core/issues/30419 but never properly made into request, I believe. I've tested proposed code on my setup with two KNX AC's units (ME-AC-KNX-1-V2 by Intesis) and didn't find any caveats. Before it was always set to heat mode if it was turned on, no matter the actual mode it was working in. Also heat mode was duplicated in UI. Basically component was broken for my use. Now everything works as expected. I didn't add anything to proposed code, just making a pull request, so you can maybe test it and possibly merge it.

pr_comments: This would break climate devices using on/off binary group addresses that don't support climate_mode DPT 20.105 - this is true for many heating actuators Controlling floor heating.
@farmio can we make config option to choose between this two types of devices?

Would be an option, but in this case we can just evaluate if one, the other or both are configured - without additional config parameter. 
You can also have a look at the "next" branch on xknx and https://github.com/XKNX/xknx/pull/319 - I have made some changes to climate there, but I want to add on/off to be part of `ClimateMode` which should make this a lot easier to implement.
It's somewhere around this commit https://github.com/XKNX/xknx/commit/49fc5977c198d548cead13f2e86bf216ee2bf52f already merged to the next branch.
Nice, it will solve the issue of doubling of the "heat" mode, if I remember correctly.

I have integrated some of your changes now. https://github.com/XKNX/xknx/commit/e52e4770d3ae2102ea60d590ae925f4c75e0e13c

But I don't know what the difference between hvac_action and hvac_mode is. Looks the same to me 🙃

The underlying issue should be solved by #39219 (coming with HA 0.115)
I think this can be closed now. Please let us know if you encounter any further issues.
@farmio great news! Sorry I was busy and couldn't test your changes yet. Do you want me to close this now, or wait until I test, if #39219 solves all issues?

Well, the whole knx integration had to be changed in this pr so your changes probably won't merge easily. I have had a look and integrated some of your proposals while preserving functionality for other devices. 

I still don't know what hvac_action does 🤣

Okay, I will see what update brings, and then be working from that.
hvac_action, i believe sets current mode. Without setting hvac_action, HA thermostat doesn't show current mode. So you can select "Cool" or "Dry" for example, it will change physically, but won't update in UI.

In 0.115, the problem is still here for climate supporting both operation_modes and on_off.
Setting Cool always returns Heating to HA :(

I tried to update climate.py but no luck this time.

Another problem is that if you use an HA sensor for the climate temperature_address, the climate does not get the temperature.
Its very annoying because, my sensor are not KNX ones, but are computed by HA and exposed to KNX bus. It was working on previous version.

property hvac_action in climate.py still not exists

EDIT
I have made some debug

issue_context.title: XKNX Climate component still have little bugs
issue_context.body:
**Home Assistant release with the issue:**
0.103.4

**Last working Home Assistant release (if known):**
0.95 (before HVAC refactor)

**Operating environment (Hass.io/Docker/Windows/etc.):**
Hass.io

**Integration:**



**Description of problem:**
As described in this issue https://github.com/home-assistant/home-assistant/issues/25247#issuecomment-513582743 the XKNX component still have weird behavior.

In hvac_mode climate.py function, set the hvac_mode when supports_on_off is supported and device is on, always set heat mode... I suggest comment/remove the two lines shown like my link.

In hvac_modes climate.py function, HVAC_MODE_HEAT is always added if supports_on_off is supported, so the HVAC_MODE_HEAT is added twice in the supported mode list.

In async_set_hvac_mode climate.py function, when requested mode is HVAC_MODE_HEAT, the code just turn on the device... don't understand why. I suggest to comment the two lines and call systematically turn_on before setting the operation mode.

 
Here is the updated file I use in my knx custom_component 

[climate.txt](https://github.com/home-assistant/home-assistant/files/4017689/climate.txt)

Happy new year to all of you :)
comments:
I also add the hvac_action property as it is missing in the official climate.py and some component use it.

    @property
    def hvac_action(self):
        """The current HVAC action (heating, cooling)"""
        mode = self.hvac_mode
        if mode == HVAC_MODE_FAN_ONLY:
            return CURRENT_HVAC_IDLE
        if mode == HVAC_MODE_HEAT:
            return CURRENT_HVAC_HEAT
        if mode == HVAC_MODE_COOL:
            return CURRENT_HVAC_COOL
        if mode == HVAC_MODE_DRY:
            return CURRENT_HVAC_DRY
        return CURRENT_HVAC_OFF
